events.title: Kon Honaar Crorepati
events.synopsis: Hosted by Madhuri Dixit, Kon Honar Crorepati is a thrilling Marathi quiz show where knowledge, courage and smart decisions can change lives. Contestants take on challenging questions for a chance to win a life-changing prize, while the new season raises the stakes with a fresh energy and one promise: Aata Khel Badalnar!

events.title: Kaun Banega Crorepati
events.synopsis: Kaun Banega Crorepati Season 18 is here on Sony LIV! Join Amitabh Bachchan as India's biggest quiz show returns, championing the power of applied knowledge with the new theme, “Sochna Padega.” In a world where information is everywhere, what matters is how you apply it. Watch every episode, play along live on Sony LIV, answer questions in real time, and stand a chance to win exciting prizes.
